finding.title: Input Validation: The constructor takes an int16_t pin number and a boolean polarity. There is no validation to ensure that the pin number is within a valid range for the microcontroller.
Default Constructor: The class does not have a default constructor, which might be a concern if an object is instantiated without providing a pin number.
Error Handling: The begin() method sets the pin mode to INPUT, but there is no error handling to check if the pin mode setting was successful.
